design_summary: A procedural crafting and inventory area where each class assembles unique weapons from three class-specific components that drive stats, appearance, and a generated name. Materials come from enemy drops, boss rewards, mini-muffin currency, and secret areas. As of migration the area is design-only; no crafting, inventory, or shop systems have shipped.

epics.title: Procedural Weapon Crafting
epics.summary: A large, design-gated feature letting each class craft weapons from three components (per-class slots) that determine stats, visuals, and a procedurally generated bakery-themed name. Includes rarity tiers, a crafting station, material drops, and a mini-muffin currency shop. No implementation has shipped; the backlog marks it as needing a design phase first.

stories.title: Design Phase
stories.summary: Define the component system, stat modifiers, name-generation rules, material sources, and crafting UI before implementation. The weapon_crafting.md design memo captures the initial pass.

tasks.title: Define weapon component system per class (see design doc)
Define name generation rules (funny, short, readable)
Define crafting material sources (drops, muffin currency, boss rewards)

stories.title: Weapon Components Per Class
stories.summary: Implement the three-slot component set for each class so weapons assemble from class-specific parts.

stories.title: Name Generation
stories.summary: Build a template-driven name generator producing funny bakery-themed weapon names from rarity, material, and effect word lists.

tasks.title: Create word lists per component (funny/bakery themed)
Examples: "Crispy Gingerbread Sword of Sprinkles", "Soggy Muffin Dagger of Crumbs"

stories.title: Crafting System Implementation
stories.summary: Build the crafting station, drag-to-combine UI, material inventory, equip/swap flow, and wire crafted weapon stats into combat.

tasks.title: Crafting station in overworld (or between towers)
Weapon stats affect combat (damage, speed, effects)

stories.title: Crafting Materials
stories.summary: Source crafting materials from enemy drops, boss rewards, and a mini-muffin currency shop, with storage UI.

tasks.title: Common drops from enemies (flour, sugar, sprinkles)
Rare drops from bosses (enchanted icing, golden crumbs)
Muffin currency can buy base materials
